name: Rate Sheet
description: The group's governed exchange rates (konsol#592): a Statutory sheet holds a rate pair per currency for one fiscal period, a Constant sheet one rate per pair for a fiscal year. Group finance enters or pre-fills them; submitting is the approval. Translation reads only approved sheets.

fields.label: Rate Basis
fields.description: Statutory: the rates for one fiscal period, used to translate actuals. Constant: a Constant sheet holds one rate per currency pair for a whole fiscal year, used for both average and closing (konsol#592 QA-1); budget, forecast and constant-currency comparisons translate at it. A Constant sheet locks when its fiscal year is closed (P1-Q2 B): until then a correction supersedes it and restates the earlier months' comparisons. Cannot be changed after the first save.

fields.label: Fiscal Period
fields.description: The period number, as on Period Status (0 = Opening, 1-12 Regular). The Closing period takes no rates. Statutory sheets only.

fields.label: Valid From
fields.description: Derived from the declared fiscal calendar on save.

fields.label: Valid To
fields.description: Derived from the declared fiscal calendar on save.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Set by the workflow: Approved is the submitted document, Cancelled the cancelled one.

fields.label: Copied From
fields.description: The sheet that Duplicate Previous proposed this draft from. Reference only: approving this sheet does not change that one.

fields.label: Reason for Change
fields.description: Required when this sheet corrects an approved one (Supersedes) or amends a cancelled one, and when a rate moves more than the Rate Move Needing a Reason in Close Settings. The sheet it replaces and this reason are the audit trail.

fields.label: Supersedes
fields.description: The approved sheet of the same key that this correction replaces (konsol#312-3). Approving this sheet cancels that one in the same step, so the key always has one approved sheet. An approved sheet is never cancelled on its own (konsol#312-S3-2): correct it with another sheet.
